question: What will be the HCF of (2 × 2 × 3 × 3 × 5 × 7 × 7 × 11), (2 × 3 × 3 × 5 × 11), (2 × 3 × 3 × 5 × 7 × 11 × 11), (2 × 3 × 3 × 5 × 5 × 11), (2 × 3 × 5 × 7 × 7)?
solution:
**Given:**

(2 × 2 × 3 × 3 × 5 × 7 × 7 × 11), (2 × 3 × 3 × 5 × 11), (2 × 3 × 3 × 5 × 7 × 11 × 11), (2 × 3 × 3 × 5 × 5 × 11), (2 × 3 × 5 × 7 × 7)

**Formula used:**

HCF = Product of lowest powers of common prime factors

**Calculations:**

Common primes: 2, 3, 5

Lowest powers: 2¹, 3¹, 5¹

HCF = 2 × 3 × 5 ⇒ 30

**Answer:**

The HCF is **30**.
